_comment: Process catalogue, product baseline S4CORE: SAP standard processes of the S/4HANA core every system runs (background jobs, electronic bank statement). Definitions and monitoring templates only; the activation is the customer's (docs/PROCESS_CATALOGUE.md). Names marked "verify" are VERIFY items (docs/VERIFY.md); monitoring rows are delivered inactive.

processes.description: Every system runs background jobs: the one baseline process active by default. Monitored by the framework's SAP job monitor (docs/JOB_MONITORING.md); a consumer usually runs it in its own job area and maps that business process here (CAT_PROCESS).
